text: Six arms... is it a bug?
BZZT! Not a bug! Six arms are not six legs. And my pages are... frozen!
Frozen? Oh no! Each page keeps a secret sense.
Remember the secret... and the page melts!
Hurry... I'm getting so sleepy... Let's wake up your pages!
Big secrets of tiny bugs! Page one... taste! I'll warm it up!
Which one will Flutter pick?
Too sour!
Not yummy!
Flutter picked the sweet one! But how did Flutter know?
With its tongue... or its feet? Three... two... one!
Its feet! Butterflies taste with their feet!
Secret unlocked! One page warm... three to go! Ooh, this page smells funny!
Page two... smell! A maze! The trail only shows in my lens.
I'll sniff the way with my antennae!
Left or right?
Left!
Up or down?
Nope! Oops! I forgot to sniff!
Left or right?
Right!
Tap, tap, hello! Ants sniff with their antennae... ...and follow smell trails!
Secret unlocked! Two pages warm! Shh... I hear music!
Page three... hearing!
Let's find their ears! Ears go on heads... right? Nope!
Chirp's ears are on its front legs!
And Hop? On its head? Nope!
Hop's ears are on its tummy!
Ears on legs... ears on tummies!
Secret unlocked! Three pages warm!
Page four... sight and signals!
I'll sneak up on Zip... shh!
How did Zip see me? Its giant eyes cover most of its head!
Blink, do you know a secret? I'm not glowing! Your tail says you do!
Some fireflies flash their own secret code!
And Waggle's dance shows the way...
Secret unlocked! Four pages warm!
This page is empty! Where do bugs go in winter? No memory... no secret...
Then I'll find a new one... outside! I'll keep Albie warm!
My family's snug under the ground!
Brr! So cold!
Is anyone home?
Honeybees huddle in a warm ball!
Ladybugs nap together under leaves!
One, two, three... so many!
A woolly bear caterpillar! It freezes all winter... ...and wakes up in spring!
Oh no! I can't see!
Heat lens... on!
The warm window! That way!
Three winter secrets!
Secret unlocked! All my pages are warm! Do you remember?
Where does a butterfly taste?
With its feet! What do ants sniff with?
Antennae! Where are a grasshopper's ears?
On its tummy! And where do ladybugs nap?
Together, under leaves!
Time for a winter nap? See you in spring! Look closely... even in winter.
Ah... ah... CHOO!
Now THAT'S a bug!
Did you spot Rollo?
Watch again and find him!
